question: Who is the highest run scorer in an over in a test match cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaspreet Bumrah**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Jaspreet Bumrah** is the highest run scorer in an over in a test match cricket.
 
• He achieved this feat by scoring 35 runs in a single over, surpassing the previous record held by Brian Lara.
 
• This record-breaking performance took place during a test match against England in July 2022.
 
• Bumrah's over included two sixes, four fours, a single, five wides and a no-ball.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Test cricket** is the longest form of the sport of cricket and is considered its highest standard.
 
• The **International Cricket Council (ICC)** is the global governing body for cricket and oversees the rules and regulations of the game.
 
• Scoring runs in cricket involves a combination of skill, strategy, and sometimes a bit of luck.
 
• Records in cricket are often celebrated and remembered as significant achievements in the sport.
